prose: Bloomberg reports that some Google employees say Gemini 4 performs well on benchmarks but struggles with some real-world coding tasks, and that Google disputes this. The company has begun rolling out Gemini 4 Argon, its flagship model. Based on the Techmeme excerpt; this is the same story as the Hacker News link to the Bloomberg piece.
highlights: Employees: strong benchmarks, weaker on some real coding
